content: Dyslexia/legibility fonts: OpenDyslexic evidence is thin (Wery & Diliberto 2017, PMC5629233: no gain in rate or accuracy) but requested by name for b/d reversals; Lexend built for reading fluency, Vanderbilt-validated speed gains, helps visual crowding; Atkinson Hyperlegible (Braille Institute 2020) disambiguates I/l/1, O/0, rn/m for low vision. All three are free/OFL. Tone settings: ChatGPT 'Base style and tone' + personality presets (Default, Cynic, Robot, Listener, Nerd) plus custom instructions; Claude Styles per chat (Normal, Learning, Concise, Explanatory, Formal) plus account-wide instructions. Local reminders: browser Notification API works while a page/PWA is open, Notification Triggers are not broadly shipped; local-first apps pair in-app notifications with .ics export.
